name: AI, Cloud and Data Chapter (AICDC)
blurb: Shape SGTech's agenda on AI, cloud and data. Join working groups, speak at events, or co-author thought-leadership.

name: Cyber Security Chapter (CSC)
blurb: Help strengthen Singapore's cyber posture. Contribute to advisories, mentor SMEs, or run a security clinic.

name: Data Centre Chapter (DCC)
blurb: Advance sustainable, high-performance data centre infrastructure and the ecosystem around it.

name: Singapore Enterprise Chapter (SEC)
blurb: Represent the interests of local tech enterprises and SMEs; help peers scale regionally.

name: Smart Nation Chapter (SNC)
blurb: Co-create digital public infrastructure and smart-city solutions with government and industry.
ways_to_contribute: Contribute to a Smart Nation position paper

name: Digital Transformation Chapter (DxC)
blurb: Help traditional industries digitalise. Share transformation playbooks and mentor adopters.

name: AI & Cloud Summit 2026 — Gold Sponsor
blurb: Flagship AI & cloud conference (~800 attendees). Gold sponsors get a keynote slot, booth and logo placement.

name: Cyber Security Forum — Partner Package
blurb: Half-day CISO forum. Partners get a panel seat, demo table and attendee list access (opt-in).

name: SME Digitalisation Bootcamp — Enabling Sponsor
blurb: Hands-on bootcamp series for SMEs. Enabling sponsors provide tooling credits and mentors, gaining goodwill and pipeline.

name: Smart Nation Expo — Innovation Showcase
blurb: Public-sector-facing expo. Showcase sponsors get a stand in the innovation zone and intros to agency buyers.
